## 🌎 Geopolitics

### Trump confirms US strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island as shipping lanes descend into chaos

The United States carried out limited strikes against Iranian air-defense systems on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz on November 6–7, Trump confirmed on November 7, marking the latest round of escalation after strikes on November 3. At least eleven commercial vessels were attacked in the strait during the week ending November 6, with three sinking; Iranian forces reported a tanker hit a mine and caught fire. Tehran has launched over 600 drone and anti-ship missile attacks since March 2026, and mediators are racing to contain the conflict before it spirals into full-scale war.

**Why it matters.** India imports roughly 20 percent of its crude from Iran and relies on stable passage through the Strait of Hormuz for energy security. Escalation in this corridor directly threatens domestic fuel costs, inflation, and the energy assumptions underpinning India's development roadmap. For a prop trader or quant research analyst, regional oil volatility has cascaded into VIX moves and currency carry reversals; for Hyderabad's growing supply chain and logistics sector, disrupted tanker routes mean higher freight costs and delayed imports. Any full-scale US-Iran war would force India to choose between energy self-sufficiency (renewable push) and geopolitical neutrality (which Washington will test).

**Action.** Monitor UK Maritime Trade Operations weekly shipping reports and the US Energy Information Administration's crude price futures to watch how much premium Iran conflict is adding to Brent. Set up alerts on Iranian oil production (track via secondary sources, not the regime) and watch for any Trump signals that he will escalate beyond "minor strikes." Conversations with India-focused macro funds should focus on whether their Iran oil price assumptions hold if the US and Iran enter direct military confrontation.

*Sources: [aljazeera.com](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/7/qeshm-island-and-hormuz-hit-as-mediators-try-to-prevent-us-iran-escalation) · [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/07/trump-us-minor-strikes-iran-qeshm-island.html) · [nbcnews.com](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/us-conducted-defensive-strikes-iranian-targets-strait-hormuz-us-offici-rcna607161)*

### China confirms talks on first-ever trilateral Trump-Xi-Putin summit at APEC as great powers jostle for position

China announced on November 4–5, for the first time, that it is in talks with the US and Russia about a possible three-way summit between Trump, Xi Jinping, and Putin at the APEC summit in Shenzhen on November 18–19. Putin proposed the idea in an October 9 call to Trump; Moscow reportedly wants to use the format to secure Ukraine negotiations on favorable terms, while Trump has signaled focus on nuclear disarmament and Xi appears lukewarm despite potential diplomatic gains. No meeting has been confirmed, and sources differ on whether Beijing will actually host it.

**Why it matters.** A confirmed trilateral signals a recalibration of great-power competition at a moment when Trump enters his final two years weakened by midterm losses and Russia faces continued war in Ukraine. For India—balancing relationships with all three powers, reliant on Russian oil, and a partner to the US on China encirclement—the shape of any US-China-Russia bargain will define how much freedom of action New Delhi retains in its own region. A Ukraine deal on Moscow's terms could free Russian capital and military focus to move toward the India-China border; a nuclear accord between Trump and Xi could reshape the Taiwan equation and Indo-Pacific trade rules that govern India's export competitiveness.

**Action.** Watch APEC's November 18–19 schedule obsessively—any trilateral announcement will move geopolitical risk pricing immediately. Analyze whether any deal text touches on Taiwan, North Korea, or energy sanctions (Russia's shadow fleet tanker reprieve). For India-market research and consulting work, prepare scenarios: Ukraine negotiated settlement, nuclear diplomacy acceleration, status quo with no agreement. Each reshapes India's hedging calculus on energy, defense, and tech sovereignty.

*Sources: [meduza.io](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/04/china-confirms-for-the-first-time-that-it-s-in-talks-over-a-possible-trump-xi-putin-meeting) · [themoscowtimes.com](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/03/russia-china-and-us-summit-under-discussion-kremlin-says-a94163) · [aljazeera.com](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/6/what-a-trump-xi-putin-summit-would-mean-and-what-it-wouldnt)*

## 🧠 Artificial Intelligence

### DeepMind's AI agents crack legacy RSA-1024, compress cryptanalysis from years to weeks

Google DeepMind announced November 6, 2026 that human-guided AI agents found two new weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA encryption. One delivers a 1600× improvement in signature forgery attacks (though requiring partial attacker control of signed data); the other enables batch factoring at roughly 30× the cost of individual keys via the number field sieve. The work took weeks rather than years, marking a concrete example of AI agents accelerating cryptanalysis workflows.

**Why it matters.** This is not autonomous cryptanalysis—Pushmeet Kohli, DeepMind's VP of Science, frames it as AI-assisted research with human guidance. But it shows agents compressing a multi-year research pipeline into weeks, shifting the time-to-insight for attackers targeting obsolete deployments. Modern 2048-bit RSA remains unaffected. For AI engineers building agentic systems, this demonstrates a real capability boundary: agents can now co-author research papers on problems that previously required years of human effort. For security practitioners, it's a concrete reason to migrate 1024-bit keys faster—the attack surface just got tighter.

**Action.** If you operate legacy 1024-bit RSA anywhere (old TLS, X.509 chains, HSM firmware), this is not a drill. Migrate to 2048-bit minimum, or 3072/4096 if crypto-agility is still pending. For agentic system architects, read the full DeepMind papers when available—understanding exactly where human guidance was needed will inform how much autonomy to grant your own agents on research-class tasks.

### Google ships Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash—15-second 4K video, 30% cheaper, multi-turn editing

Google released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash on November 5, 2026. The video model now generates clips up to 15 seconds (previously 10), outputs 4K with synchronized audio, and supports multi-turn conversational editing so users can iterate without regenerating the entire clip. Pricing dropped 30% to $0.07 per second at 720p resolution via the Gemini API and Google Cloud, rolling out to consumer surfaces (Flow, Google Vids, Google Ads, Gemini app).

**Why it matters.** Longer clips and native audio address production workflow friction—marketing and content teams no longer need separate audio engineering or clip stitching. Multi-turn editing cuts iteration cost. For practitioners building video generation into products, the price floor just moved, making automation of ad creative, teaser content, and stock footage generation viable at scale. For comparison shoppers, Omni 1.2 Flash is now competitive with lower-tier video models on cost while remaining a general-purpose multimodal system rather than video-only. The 4K + audio baseline signals Google is pushing Omni away from prototype territory toward embedded inference.

**Action.** Benchmark Omni 1.2 Flash against your existing video model on reference adherence and physics consistency—Google flagged fast motion and complex dynamics as remaining weak points. If you're today using a video-only commodity model or stitching Omni 1.1 with separate audio APIs, test the direct replacement cost before architecture changes. Monitor whether Google expands clip length beyond 15 seconds in the next quarter; 30-45 second clips would be the next capability ceiling to watch.

*Sources: [[https://www.androidauthority.com/google-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-announced-3732209/](https://www.androidauthority.com/google-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-announced-3732209/)]([https://www.androidauthority.com/google-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-announced-3732209/](https://www.androidauthority.com/google-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-announced-3732209/)) · [[https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/05/google-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-15-second-video/](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/05/google-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-15-second-video/)]([https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/05/google-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-15-second-video/](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/05/google-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-15-second-video/)) · [[https://mlq.ai/news/google-releases-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-with-15-second-video-and-lower-api-pricing/](https://mlq.ai/news/google-releases-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-with-15-second-video-and-lower-api-pricing/)]([https://mlq.ai/news/google-releases-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-with-15-second-video-and-lower-api-pricing/](https://mlq.ai/news/google-releases-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-with-15-second-video-and-lower-api-pricing/))*

## 🇮🇳 India

### EloElo Group Closes $80 Million Series C, Valuation Crosses $1 Billion in AI-Driven Wealth Management

EloElo Group, an Indian wealthtech and financial services platform, raised $80 million in its Series C funding round on November 4, 2026, led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal. The round pushed the company into unicorn territory. Existing investors including Ratan Tata and others also participated, signaling confidence in its AI-powered portfolio advisory and automated wealth management stack.

**Why it matters.** For an AI engineer in Hyderabad building fintech automation or applying to Series C-stage startups, EloElo's scale and investor confidence validate the market appetite for AI-native wealth platforms in India. The company's trajectory—from seed to $1B valuation in three years—reflects how aggressively Indian VCs are backing AI applications in regulated financial services, even as policy (RBI's FREE-AI framework and SEBI's yet-to-finalize ML guidelines) remains in draft. If you're building recommendation engines or compliance automation for financial services, this signals realistic funding timelines and realistic customer acquisition costs in this segment.

**Action.** Review EloElo's Series C press release and investor roster to identify which venture firms are backing AI fintech right now. Track the company's hiring on LinkedIn (especially for ML engineers and compliance architects) as a proxy for their product roadmap. Check Hornbill Capital's and NBCUniversal's portfolio for other AI fintech bets in India—they signal trend direction. Monitor SEBI's November finalization of ML governance guidelines, since wealthtech platforms will be among the first to be audited under them.

*Sources: [[Inc42: From GIVA To EloElo Group — Indian Startups Raised $255 Mn This Week](https://inc42.com/buzz/from-giva-to-eloelo-group-indian-startups-raised-255-mn/)]([Inc42: From GIVA To EloElo Group — Indian Startups Raised $255 Mn This Week](https://inc42.com/buzz/from-giva-to-eloelo-group-indian-startups-raised-255-mn/)) · [[StartupTalky: Daily Indian Funding Roundup — 4 November 2026](https://startuptalky.com/news/daily-indian-funding-roundup-key-news-4-november-2026/)]([StartupTalky: Daily Indian Funding Roundup — 4 November 2026](https://startuptalky.com/news/daily-indian-funding-roundup-key-news-4-november-2026/))*

### CERT-In Alerts Fintech Firms to AI-Powered Cyberattacks; Crafty Falcon Campaign Targets APIs and Lending Platforms

India's national cybersecurity agency CERT-In issued a formal advisory on November 4, 2026, warning all non-banking financial companies, digital lenders, fintech firms, payment aggregators, and crypto exchanges of an active, ongoing campaign deploying AI tools to discover vulnerabilities and execute unauthorised fund transfers. The threat actor, named Crafty Falcon, uses four distinct attack tools, at least two linked to Chinese infrastructure, to compromise payment and disbursement APIs and initiate unauthorised transactions.

**Why it matters.** If you're an AI engineer at a fintech startup or building payment orchestration services in India, this advisory reframes your security investment from optional to existential. Attackers are now using AI to automate reconnaissance and payload delivery at scale—your API's rate-limiting, transaction-signing protocols, and anomaly detection all became immediate priorities. The advisory also signals that regulatory bodies (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI) will tighten AI governance and security audits on fintech firms in Q4 2026. Budget for AI-driven adversarial testing and consider SOC-2 Type II audits if you're pre-Series B and haven't yet completed them. The Union Home Ministry's cybercrime coordination centre (I4C) issued a parallel warning the same week, suggesting this is now a cross-agency priority.

**Action.** Register for CERT-In's advisory tracking and automated vulnerability feeds. Audit your APIs—especially payment, disbursement, and settlement endpoints—for API key rotation, rate-limiting, request signing, and transaction authorization controls. Review your threat model against Crafty Falcon's known tactics (AI-driven fuzzing, OAuth/API key compromise, transaction replay). If you use third-party payment or lending APIs, request your vendor's incident response plan and their countermeasures against this specific campaign. Monitor RBI and SEBI news in late November for formalized AI security mandates that may become binding on regulated entities.

*Sources: [[Infosecurity Magazine: India Warns of New AI-Driven Cyber-Attacks Targeting Financial Sector](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/india-warns-ai-cyberattacks/)]([Infosecurity Magazine: India Warns of New AI-Driven Cyber-Attacks Targeting Financial Sector](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/india-warns-ai-cyberattacks/)) · [[The 420.in: Cert-In AI Cyber Gang Targets Banks, Fintech Firms](https://the420.in/i4c-ai-powered-cyberattacks-banks-fintech/)]([The 420.in: Cert-In AI Cyber Gang Targets Banks, Fintech Firms](https://the420.in/i4c-ai-powered-cyberattacks-banks-fintech/)) · [[Business Standard: China-linked tools used in AI-driven cyberattacks on Indian financial firms](https://www.business-standard.com/industry/news/china-linked-tools-used-in-ai-driven-cyberattacks-on-indian-financial-firms-126110500996_1.html)]([Business Standard: China-linked tools used in AI-driven cyberattacks on Indian financial firms](https://www.business-standard.com/industry/news/china-linked-tools-used-in-ai-driven-cyberattacks-on-indian-financial-firms-126110500996_1.html))*

## 📈 Markets

### AI rout pivots on Congress threat; RBI tightens into sticky inflation

Friday's 1.1% Nasdaq bounce to 24,579.42 and S&P 500 gain to 7,376.86 masked a brutal underlying trend: Thursday's 5.52% Nasdaq collapse on fears that Democratic control of Congress (won Nov 3) will curb data-center construction and AI financing. The Dow fell 0.46% Friday despite the broader relief rally, signaling weak conviction. Meanwhile, India's Nifty 50 extended a 7-day rally to ~25,030 and Sensex to ~81,028, driven by foreign inflows and falling crude — but this masks October's inflation print of 5.54%, forcing the RBI to hike its repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% on October 7, its first increase since February 2023.

**Why it matters.** The tech selloff cuts at the heart of the AI capex cycle that has underwritten market valuations since 2023. A Democratic Congress hostile to data-center expansion threatens the GPU and semiconductor buildouts that fund Nvidia, AMD, and cloud infrastructure. For India's markets, the RBI's October 25-bp hike and shift to "calibrated tightening" signals no pause in rate hikes even as external conditions (falling oil, stronger rupee reserve inflows) should theoretically allow it. The mismatch points to domestic inflation still exceeding the RBI's 4% target and CPI expected to breach 6% by November. Quant prop desks tracking AI valuations vs. policy risk now face a new regime: regulatory headwind instead of secular tailwind.

**Action.** Watch the October US CPI (due November 10 at 8:30 a.m. ET) — if it reads hot, the 77% market odds of a December Fed hike harden, and rupee carry will tighten further. The RBI's next meeting on December 2–4 will test whether it holds or hikes again; the outcome hinges on food and crude prices and the rupee's reaction to Fed tightening. Monitor tech sector positioning for signs of a duration/AI bubble unwind that could spill into India's financials and IT outsourcing stocks.

*Sources: [[Topstep Weekly Market Kickoff: November 8, 2026](https://www.topstep.com/blog/weekly-market-kickoff)]([Topstep Weekly Market Kickoff: November 8, 2026](https://www.topstep.com/blog/weekly-market-kickoff)) · [[24/7 Wall Street: Jobs Report and Rate Hike Odds](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/07/odds-of-a-december-rate-hike-jump-to-77-after-a-blowout-jobs-report)]([24/7 Wall Street: Jobs Report and Rate Hike Odds](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/07/odds-of-a-december-rate-hike-jump-to-77-after-a-blowout-jobs-report)) · [[RBI MPC October 2026 Rate Hike](https://www.corplawupdates.in/updates/rbi-repo-rate-hike-5-50-percent-october-2026)]([RBI MPC October 2026 Rate Hike](https://www.corplawupdates.in/updates/rbi-repo-rate-hike-5-50-percent-october-2026)) · [[Business Standard: India Market Close Nov 6](https://www.business-standard.com/amp/markets/news/stock-market-live-november-6-nse-bse-sensex-today-nifty50-gift-nifty-crude-oil-prices-q2-results-today-dhanteras-126110600099_1.html)]([Business Standard: India Market Close Nov 6](https://www.business-standard.com/amp/markets/news/stock-market-live-november-6-nse-bse-sensex-today-nifty50-gift-nifty-crude-oil-prices-q2-results-today-dhanteras-126110600099_1.html))*

### Geopolitical de-escalation crashes oil; rupee window narrows before December inflation

Brent crude fell to ~$97 per barrel (down 14% on the week) and WTI December futures to $89.93 (down 13.58% on the week) as the Democratic Congress sweep raised market expectations for de-escalation or negotiation in the U.S.–Iran conflict. The move follows months of oil-driven inflation pressure in India, where transport and food-basket costs pushed headline CPI above 5.5%. Foreign investors have returned to India's equity markets this week, sensing lower imported inflation, but the rupee has not yet fully recovered its losses against the dollar.

**Why it matters.** Oil is India's largest inflation wildcard. A sustained $90–$95 Brent environment takes immense pressure off the RBI's inflation target and the rupee, which has weakened against the dollar as US rates stayed elevated and India's rate cycle lagged. Falling oil prices could delay the RBI's next rate hike or soften its stance, though headline CPI is still sticky due to food inflation and currency pass-through. For traders, the rupee's relief here is borrowed: the 77% odds of a December Fed hike and the carry-trade unwinding from tech volatility could quickly reverse flows, and the next RBI meeting's language on tightening will be decisive.

**Action.** Watch oil inventory reports (US crude supply Tuesday, API Wednesday) — a sustained $85–$95 range would allow the RBI to hold in December rather than hike. Track the rupee's reaction to the October CPI print and Fed rate-hike probability path; a break above 83.50 per dollar would signal rupee weakness resuming despite oil weakness, a tell that policy divergence (tight Fed vs. cautious RBI) is overriding commodity flows.

*Sources: [[Market News: Oil Falls on Post-Election Peace Hopes](https://www.journalarta.com/en/2026/11/08/democrats-congress-sweep-puts-80-year-rally-record-in-focus)]([Market News: Oil Falls on Post-Election Peace Hopes](https://www.journalarta.com/en/2026/11/08/democrats-congress-sweep-puts-80-year-rally-record-in-focus)) · [[CNBC: Fed Daly on Rate Hikes and Inflation](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/fed-daly-interest-rates-inflation.html)]([CNBC: Fed Daly on Rate Hikes and Inflation](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/fed-daly-interest-rates-inflation.html)) · [[RBI Repo Rate and Policy Stance](https://www.forbesindia.com/article/news/rbi-mpc-rate-hike-in-focus-as-inflation-oil-rise/2999105/1)]([RBI Repo Rate and Policy Stance](https://www.forbesindia.com/article/news/rbi-mpc-rate-hike-in-focus-as-inflation-oil-rise/2999105/1))*

## 💹 Global Stocks

### INTC (NASDAQ): −28.6% after weak Q4 guidance despite Q3 earnings beat

Intel shares collapsed 28.6% on November 2 following third-quarter 2026 earnings that beat estimates but included a disastrous forward guide. The company forecast Q4 revenue of $15.0–16.0 billion, sharply below the Street consensus of approximately $17.0 billion. By November 5, Intel had stabilized at $52.25, down 10.33% that day, as the chip sector selloff broadened across foundries and fabless players on renewed anxiety over AI data-center capex cycles.

**Why it matters.** Intel's stumble—weak PC demand and a shaky server outlook despite strong Q3 bookings—signals that AI buildout euphoria may be hitting reality. The chipmaker's inability to capitalize on semis scarcity while competitors like TSMC and ASML shipped at peak utilization suggests either demand destruction or Intel-specific execution risk. For Indian investors tracking Infosys, TCS, and HCL supply-chain exposure to the AI boom, this is a yellow flag that semis tailwinds may not be as durable as assumed; capex cycles can whip-saw faster than consensus catches on.

**Action.** Read Intel's Q3 2026 10-Q filing (due within 45 days of quarter-end, or search SEC EDGAR for the November filing) and the earnings call transcript. Watch the November 15 options expiry flow; if institutional holders keep unloading, the $45–50 band will become key support. Cross-check guidance revisions against TSMC and Samsung forward comments at their next earnings; if those two maintain raised capex, Intel's miss looks idiosyncratic, not cyclical.

*Sources: [[Stock Market Today (Nov. 5): Intel Falls on Weak Fourth-Quarter Sales Outlook](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-nov-5-222216828.html)]([Stock Market Today (Nov. 5): Intel Falls on Weak Fourth-Quarter Sales Outlook](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-nov-5-222216828.html)) · [[The Stock Market Today, November 5, 2026, Closed Sharply Lower as the AI Chip Selloff Spread](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-5-2026/)]([The Stock Market Today, November 5, 2026, Closed Sharply Lower as the AI Chip Selloff Spread](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-5-2026/))*

### GOOGL (NASDAQ): −6.6% after Q3 EPS miss; capex guidance fuels broader tech retreat

Alphabet (Google) posted third-quarter 2026 earnings per share of $2.12, missing the consensus estimate of $3.02. The shortfall triggered a $319.48 close from $341.91 the prior day, a 6.56% single-session decline that rippled into the S&P 500's worst day since April 2025. The broader market fell 4.36% on November 5 as investors repriced AI capex expectations downward: Alphabet's disclosed 2026 capex trajectory of $175–205 billion—more than double 2025 actual—spooked large-cap watchers who worry margin compression from the AI arms race may persist longer than modeled.

**Why it matters.** Alphabet's miss suggests the search/advertising engine cannot generate enough incremental cash flow to fund the AI infrastructure race while satisfying earnings expectations. The capex spike signals that Gemini, Vertex AI, and competing large-language-model workloads demand real-time compute density that traditional data-center economics no longer justify. This cascades to India: TCS and Infosys advisory and implementation revenue depends on enterprises migrating workloads to the cloud. If capex growth stalls because tech giants are underwater on AI ROI, consulting work slows. Watch Alphabet's cloud-segment revenue growth rate in the Q3 call; deceleration would confirm this thesis.

**Action.** Pull Alphabet's Q3 2026 10-Q (SEC EDGAR) and review the capex footnote and cash-flow statement. Listen to the earnings call for management commentary on cloud unit unit economics and generative AI model inference costs. Compare capex guidance ranges ($175–205B) against historical guidance errors. If year-over-year capex growth disappoints in Q4 or Q1 guidance is slashed below consensus, a capitulation move lower becomes likely.

## 🏗 Tech & Startups

### Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO

Food delivery platform Wonder filed confidentially for an initial public offering on November 5, 2026. The company has not disclosed share count, price range, or an IPO date. Wonder's confidential filing signals that the capital markets are reopening for scaled, profitable consumer mobility platforms after a multi-year downturn.

**Why it matters.** This is the first major IPO signal from the food delivery sector since DoorDash and Uber Eats consolidated the category. Wonder's move suggests founders and LPs have reset expectations around profitability thresholds before going public—no longer racing for growth at any cost. For builders, the playbook is: scale unit economics first, build repeat use, then IPO. The market will price discipline and margin expansion, not gross merchandise value alone.

**Action.** Track SEC EDGAR for Wonder's S-1 filing and price guidance. Monitor for underwriter announcements (investment banks typically announce 1–2 weeks before pricing) and note the lead banker—that signals investor demand tier. Compare Wonder's disclosed financials to DoorDash and Uber Eats' 2024 metrics on delivery frequency, order value, and take rate to benchmark if this company has solved the unit economics trap.

*Sources: [[Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/05/food-delivery-startup-wonder-files-for-ipo-as-it-explores-its-next-big-bite/)]([Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/05/food-delivery-startup-wonder-files-for-ipo-as-it-explores-its-next-big-bite/)) · [[IPOScoop](https://www.iposcoop.com/)]([IPOScoop](https://www.iposcoop.com/))*

### MakeMyTrip acquires majority stake in Bengaluru ride-pooling startup Quick Ride

Travel and mobility platform MakeMyTrip has acquired a majority stake in Bengaluru-based ride-pooling startup Quick Ride, founded by KNM Rao, announced November 6, 2026. Deal terms and stake size were not disclosed. Quick Ride's founding team will operate independently under MakeMyTrip ownership.

**Why it matters.** MakeMyTrip is consolidating mobility modes—flights, hotels, trains, buses, taxis, now ride-pooling—into a single travel ecosystem. The thesis is that ride-pooling isn't just urban commuting; it's a mission-critical last-mile for airport runs and multi-city trips. Indian travel platforms are building vertically integrated category killers, following Grab's playbook in Southeast Asia. For founders, the lesson: build one mode, then acquire or integrate adjacent modes to reduce customer churn and expand wallet share.

**Action.** Watch for product integration signals: unified booking flows between flights and rides, dynamic pricing between modes, and MakeMyTrip flight customers getting ride credits. Monitor MakeMyTrip's earnings calls for Quick Ride GMV contribution and unit economics. Track Quick Ride hiring in new geographies—expansion signals whether MakeMyTrip is scaling the bet or managing it as a feature.

### Psilocybin Rewires Brain Circuits Long-Term Without Psychoactive Effects in New Mechanism

A UC Santa Cruz study led by Jacob Baker, published in Nature Neuroscience in October 2026, found that a single dose of psilocybin increases dendritic spine formation (new synaptic connections) and that 48 percent of these spines persist 21 days post-exposure, compared to 29.3 percent in controls. The serotonin 2A receptor drives both the immediate rewiring and the retention effect. The team also identified a method to trigger spine formation without the behavioral hallucinations associated with the drug.

**Why it matters.** The discovery that psilocybin's brain-rewiring effects persist long after the acute experience ends reframes the mechanism for treating treatment-resistant depression and PTSD—the neuroplasticity is the therapeutic engine, not the subjective trip. Separating rewiring from psychoactive effects opens a path to therapeutic dosing without the patient experience burden, which lowers regulatory and patient-adoption barriers. For neuroscience-focused drug developers, this identifies serotonin 2A receptor signaling as a tuneable target for promoting adaptive circuit repair.

**Action.** Monitor for publications of the non-hallucinogenic psilocybin analogs the Baker lab is likely optimizing, or licensing deals with synthetic biology firms. If you're designing depression or trauma trials, this suggests tracking synaptic density (via PET) as a biomarker for clinical response. The combination of serotonin 2A signaling + neuroplasticity may unlock new targets for anxiety and addiction, so read the supplementary data for spine-loss dynamics in chronically stressed animals.
